t: IP20 rated wiring centre for the 221 Series 4mm² lever connectors. Base carrier can be equipped with up to 60 connection points. Features 6 snap-in, double-deck strain reliefs for routing up to 12 surface-mounted cables, as well as 3 flush-mounted cable entries in the rear wall, enabling feeding of several differently laid cables between 4-11mm diameter. Marking strip receptacles enable clear labelling of individual connections. For exclusive use with 221 Series lever connector 4mm² versions 221-412, 221-413 and 221-415 (sold separately). Designed for surface screw mounting on a wall of ceiling. Screwless cover.
b: Highly Visible Labelling for Each Connection Point
